blocks.text: Leviticus 27 contains 34 verses. It opens with: And Jehovah spake unto Moses, saying, It concludes with: These are the commandments, which Jehovah commanded Moses for the children of Israel in mount Sinai. Supplied contextual evidence for this passage adds: Leviticus moves from sacrifice and priestly inauguration through purity and the Day of Atonement into instructions for holy communal life, sacred time, land, covenant consequences, and vows.
